how-31-02-specimen.page: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the branch, then tap 3 things you notice.
how-31-02-specimen.say: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the branch, then tap three things you notice.

how-31-02-compare.page: Put the panther at one crossing and the turtle at the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Send them through. Then swap.
how-31-02-compare.say: Put the panther at one crossing and the turtle at the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Send them through. Then swap.

how-31-02-wall.page: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing stop: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the photo shows.
how-31-02-wall.say: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing stop: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the photo shows.

how-31-02-det.page: Pick 3 cards, one at a time. Tap the fact that is a constraint (a limit), then name what the design must do. Predict how it turned out, and see the evidence.
how-31-02-det.say: Pick three cards, one at a time. Tap the fact that is a constraint, a limit, then name what the design must do. Predict how it turned out, and see the evidence.

how-31-02-partc.page: Draw your design for the challenge you picked in Part B. Label at least 5 parts: the threat, your solution, at least one native plant or animal that benefits, and two more parts of your design.
how-31-02-partc.say: Draw your design for the challenge you picked in Part B. Label at least 5 parts: the threat, your solution, at least one native plant or animal that benefits, and two more parts of your design.
